narr: A lingering warm front as well as remnant outflow boundaries were the triggering mechanisms for storms. Some of the storms produced large hail, damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: Between 3 and 6 inches of rain fell in a short amount of time over portions of southeastern St. Louis County. Several roads were flooded in Affton, Crestwood, Shrewsbury, and Oakville. Both directions of I-55 was briefly flooded near the Bayless Avenue exit. Also, the parking lot at Cedar Creek Lodge Apartments was flooded with several feet of water from the nearby creek. At least a dozen cars were flooded in the parking lot.

Between 3 and 6 inches rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding over southern portions of the city. The fire department reported that several vehicles were trapped in standing water in the Carondelet neighborhood. On I-64 at Tamm Avenue overpass, flash flooding caused standing water on the highway. Several vehicles became stranded in this location after trying to drive through the flood waters.
